blocks.orig: Ole Serai Turner Springs lies in the heart of Serengeti National Park, 17 kilometres from the Seronera Airstrip. The spectacular and secluded location of this camp ensures sightings of wildlife year-round, choosing to graze around the camp due to its lagoon-type contoured landscape as water catchments border the camp on three sides. Turner Springs consists of 20 luxury tents that are set out and specially designed with maximum guest privacy in mind. The camp boasts fine dining experiences, luxurious and comfortable bedding and furnishings, and personalized butler services. Sundowners, aperitifs, and cocktails at the campfire will complete your safari experience here!
blocks.html: In the heart of Serengeti National Park, 17 kilometres from the Seronera Airstrip, you find Ole Serai Turner Springs. Thanks to the spectacular, secluded setting of the camp, you see wildlife all year round: the animals like to graze nearby because of the lagoon-like contours of the land, with water catchments on three sides of the camp. Turner Springs has 20 luxury tents, laid out and designed specially to give guests as much privacy as possible. You can look forward to fine dining, luxurious and comfortable beds and furniture, and a personal butler service. Sundowners, aperitifs and cocktails around the campfire round off your safari experience here!
